title: Notifications
settings.styleHelp: The same four as qDock's. Cupertino, Redmond and Plasma are translucent: see the README for the blur behind them.
settings.quietHelp: Bubbles stay off the screen and wait in the center.
settings.lowUrgencyHelp: Low-urgency notifications, like a screenshot saved or a layout changed, only confirm what you just did. Off, they show as bubbles but stay out of the center.
settings.hiddenAppsHelp: These apps and sites still show bubbles, but not in the center. Click one below to add it.
settings.webAppsHelp: The app a website's notification opens once its bubble is gone. Without one, qCenter opens the site's web app, else the browser.
settings.calendarsHelp: Today's events, from your calendars' private ICS links (https or webcal) or .ics files. The links are secrets: they stay in your shell.json.
settings.calendarUrlBad: An https:// or webcal:// link, or the path of an .ics file.
settings.agendaFileUsed: The agenda is read from %1 (agendaFile in shell.json): the calendars below are not used.
about.description: A notification center for Omarchy, on top of its own notifications: what you missed, Do Not Disturb, today's agenda from your calendars, and a bell for the bar.
